verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OpenAI's own evals feature (gpt-docs-17) is for customers to build their own evaluations, not documentation of the methodology behind OpenAI's published benchmark claims (e.g., no system-card level detail on eval names, exact settings, harness, or prompts used to produce claims like 'Terminal Bench 82.7%'). The one relevant community item (gpt-comm-1) is a forum reply asserting general fairness/transparency intent but contains no reproducible methodology, and gpt-comm-7 just cites a benchmark number without methodology. No first-party model/system card with eval harness or prompt disclosure is present in the pack.
